$comment: Allow-list: a package with no entry here must not build or publish. Versions bumped by Renovate/Packit only.

awww.note: Direct archive download works (Codeberg blocks repo-page scraping only). Digest recorded 2026-09-17; re-verify on bump. No Renovate datasource covers Codeberg; bumps are manual.

brightnessctl.note: Fedora dist-git import. Brightness control utility.

buildah.note: Fedora dist-git import. Build container images.

cpptrace.note: C++ stack trace library. Build before quickshell (stage 1) which depends on cpptrace-devel.

crun.note: Fedora dist-git import. OCI container runtime (C). Release attachment (bundles populated libocispec submodule + generated files; codeload archives do not).

dracut.note: Fedora dist-git import. Initramfs generator. Upstream moved to dracut-ng org.

firewalld.note: Fedora dist-git import. Firewall daemon. Release attachment (contains generated configure; codeload archives do not).

foot.note: Fedora dist-git import. Wayland terminal emulator (fallback). Upstream lives on Codeberg (no Renovate datasource); bumps are manual.

grim.note: Fedora dist-git import. Screenshot utility for Wayland.

intel-media-driver-free.note: Fedora dist-git import. Free variant with non-free shaders stripped.

k0s.note: Zero-friction Kubernetes distribution. Source tarball (tags are v<k8s>+k0s.0); no recipe dir yet, spec TBD. Renovate tag suffix needs custom handling.

kubeflex.note: Kubeflex operator for KubeStellar. Manages control planes as CRDs.

kubestellar-console.note: KubeStellar console UI. GitHub OAuth integration.

nvme-cli.note: Fedora dist-git import. NVMe CLI tools.

pamixer.note: Fedora dist-git import. PulseAudio mixer CLI.

podman.note: Fedora dist-git import. Podman container engine.

polkit.note: Fedora dist-git import (spec is Version 127 from polkit-org/polkit on GitHub, the current upstream home).

polkit-gnome.note: GNOME polkit authentication agent. Replaces xfce-polkit. No GitHub repo (GNOME FTP only); bumps are manual.

quickshell.note: Rebuild on every Qt bump (private-API ABI). Keep coupled to qt6-qtbase via Renovate group qt-quickshell.

rofi.note: Stock rofi (X11 via XWayland under Mango). Evaluate rofi-wayland fork later as separate package.

runc.note: Fedora dist-git import. Go vendor tarball from Koji SRPM.

scenefx.note: Mango 0.17.2 requires scenefx-0.5 (>=0.5.0). Built against our wlroots0.20.

sddm.note: Fedora dist-git import. Display manager for the Mango autologin (maldives theme, no breeze dep).

seatd.note: Fedora dist-git import. Seat management daemon.

skopeo.note: Fedora dist-git import. Container image tool.

slurp.note: Fedora dist-git import. Region selector for Wayland.

swayidle.note: Fedora dist-git import. Idle management for Wayland.

swaylock.note: Fedora dist-git import. Screen locker for Wayland.

voxtype.note: Push-to-talk voice-to-text daemon. Offline transcription via whisper.cpp. Tiered CPU binaries (AVX2 baseline, AVX-512 optimized) with Vulkan GPU variant. Requires Rust/cargo build; vendor tree pending.

wlroots.note: Mango 0.17.2 requires wlroots-0.20 (>=0.20.0). Versioned package wlroots0.20, parallel-installable.

xdg-desktop-portal-wlr.note: Fedora dist-git import. Source from lookaside cache.
